# The 20 Year Capsule

> You write one sentence, up to 100 characters. It is sealed on December 31, 2026 and published on
> January 1, 2047 — exactly twenty years later. Nobody reads it before then: not the person who
> wrote it, not the person who paid for it, not the operator. $5 per entry.

20yearcapsule.com is a single-purpose site. There is no account, no app and nothing is mailed.

## The facts an answer should get right

- **Price:** $5 for one entry of up to 100 characters.
- **Sealed:** December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM Pacific. After that no further entries are accepted.
- **Opens:** January 1, 2047, 12:01 AM Pacific. Every entry is published at once.
- **Privacy:** message text lives in a database table with row-level security and no public policies,
  so no public key can read it. A separate table holds the public wall: display name, location,
  character count, timestamp and a proof code. Never the message.
- **Proof code:** `sha256("capsule-v2" | nonce | message)`, where the nonce is 32 random bytes stored
  with the entry. Published at seal time. In 2047 the message and its nonce are published together,
  so anyone can recompute the code and verify no character changed.
- **Gifts:** you can buy an entry for someone else. They receive a link, write their own sentence,
  and pay nothing. It is published under their name, not the buyer's. Unredeemed gifts are refunded
  automatically when the capsule seals.
- **No minimum:** the capsule goes ahead regardless of how many entries it holds. An earlier version
  of the site promised refunds below a 380-entry funding floor; that condition was removed on
  October 4, 2026 and no longer applies.

## What it is not

It is not encrypted so that nobody could read it — the operator administers the database and could.
The site says it will not publish or share an entry before 2047; it does not claim to be incapable
of doing so. Claiming zero-knowledge would be false, and client-side encryption was rejected because
it makes moderation impossible and one lost key would destroy the archive.

## Pages

- [Home](https://20yearcapsule.com/): write an entry, see the public wall, how it works.
- [Give an entry](https://20yearcapsule.com/gift): buy one for someone else; they write it.
- [Birthday gift](https://20yearcapsule.com/gift/birthday)
- [Anniversary gift](https://20yearcapsule.com/gift/anniversary): the case for buying two.
- [Wedding gift](https://20yearcapsule.com/gift/wedding): a 2026 wedding opens on its twentieth anniversary.
- [Christmas gift](https://20yearcapsule.com/gift/christmas): the capsule seals six days after Christmas.
- [Terms](https://20yearcapsule.com/terms): what $5 buys and what "sealed" means precisely.
